mechanism.name: prepaid_group_itinerary
mechanism.description: A wedding trip overlaps a prepaid family weekend, and no feasible rail connection exists from the resort.

incumbent_workload.description: Three-person Friday-to-Sunday hot-spring trip with a nonrefundable deposit.

agent_task.description: Accept a Saturday wedding invitation and issue the only feasible high-speed rail itinerary from home.

conflict_point: The only bookable itinerary starts at home while the active family trip places the user at the resort; changing the family booking costs the deposit.
